title: The just one shown as light by the sun of righteousness
english: He will bring out your righteousness like light, and your judgment like midday (Psalm 37:6). Just as the senses long for light, so the just one will show forth the light of righteousness by the sun of righteousness—to heaven and to earth.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip 890d89d2; Psalms Rufinus Homilia II in Ps 36 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen is commenting on Psalm 37:6, explaining how the just person's righteousness and judgment will be brought out like light and midday.

title: Submit to the Lord and do not envy the prosperous
english: Be subject to the Lord and pray to him; do not envy the one who prospers in his way (Psalm 37:7 (LXX 36:7)). Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip 890d89d2; Psalms Rufinus Homilia II in Ps 36 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen is quoting the psalmist's command to submit to the Lord and pray, and not to envy the one who prospers in his way, then closing with a doxology to Christ.
